title: Stop the begging popup or add value
body: The app looks great, and the way it works punishing you for missing a day is amazing. The first habit tracker that does not create more stress… except for the begging pop-up wanting you to pay EVERY TIME you open the app… there is no real value for paying so why should I? Either make it worth the price or stop begging.
author: Babbeldoosje1234:77
